meta.title: Aurello — Bittersweet citrus, bright bubbles, ready when you are
meta.description: Aurello is a ready-to-drink aperitivo spritz. Bittersweet citrus, bright bubbles, chilled and cracked in three moves. Orange Spritz, Lemon & Mint, Pink Grapefruit.

brand.name: Aurello

intro.heading: OPEN. POUR. *GLOW.*
intro.body: No jigger, no bar spoon, no bottle of bitters you bought once and never finished. Aurello is the aperitivo hour poured whole into a cold can: Sicilian orange peel, gentian root, a long dry finish, and bubbles fine enough to keep the whole thing bright to the last sip.

product.alt: Aurello Orange Spritz can turning through the light

cards.label: 01 — THE LONG TABLE
cards.headline: SIX CHAIRS, NINE PEOPLE
cards.body: Somebody drags over a bench, somebody else opens another four. The food is late and nobody minds.
cards.alt: Friends crowded around a long table at golden hour

cards.label: 02 — THE SLOW AFTERNOON
cards.headline: FIVE O'CLOCK, ROUGHLY
cards.body: Laptops shut, shoes off, the light going amber across the terrace. The working day ends on the first crack.
cards.alt: A terrace in late afternoon light, work finished for the day

cards.label: 03 — THE ONE MORE
cards.headline: STAY FOR ANOTHER
cards.body: The plan was one drink. The plan is now dinner. Cold can, no ice run, no negotiation.
cards.alt: Portrait of someone laughing, drink in hand, sun low behind them

product.alt: Aurello can rotating as the wave rises

range.heading: THREE WAYS TO *SPRITZ*
range.body: One recipe, three moods. Each is built on the same bittersweet aperitivo base, then pulled in a different direction by the peel it is pressed with.

products.name: Orange Spritz
products.subtitle: Sicilian blood orange, gentian root, a long bitter finish.

products.name: Lemon & Mint
products.subtitle: Amalfi lemon peel, cracked garden mint, dry and cold-snapping.

products.name: Pink Grapefruit
products.subtitle: Ruby grapefruit, pink peppercorn, a soft bitter tail.

ingredients.heading: THREE THINGS, *DONE PROPERLY*
ingredients.body: There is no long ingredient list to hide behind. Everything in the can earns its place, and anything that did not make the drink brighter was taken back out.

cards.title: Sun-Bright Citrus
cards.body: Peel pressed from Sicilian blood orange and Amalfi lemon, cold-extracted so the oils stay sharp instead of turning candied.

cards.title: Aromatic Botanicals
cards.body: Gentian root and rhubarb for the bitter spine, a little pink peppercorn for lift. Macerated slowly, never rushed with heat.

cards.title: Fine Bubbles
cards.body: Carbonated cold and fine, so the first crack fizzes bright and the last mouthful still has something to say.

items.title: Chill
items.body: Four hours in the fridge, or twenty minutes buried in ice. Cold is not optional here, it is the whole recipe.

items.title: Crack
items.body: Open it flat, listen for the hiss. That sound is the bubbles arriving exactly as they were packed.

items.title: Pour
items.body: Big glass, plenty of ice, a wide slice of orange down the side. Then leave the kitchen and go and sit outside.

story.heading: THE SPARK OF *TOGETHER*
paragraphs: Aurello started at a borrowed table on a borrowed terrace, in that hour where the light goes orange and nobody wants to be the first to leave. The drinks took too long to make, so someone always missed the good part while they were inside stirring.
So we built the whole hour into a can: the bitterness, the citrus oil, the bubbles, the reason to stay. Everything you would have made yourself, if you had not been busy pouring for everybody else.
story.alt: A crowded golden-hour table, glasses raised

faq.heading: YOUR *QUESTIONS*
faq.intro: Everything people ask us before the first can, answered plainly. Anything else, the team reads every message.

items.a: Very cold, over plenty of ice, in a glass bigger than you think you need. A wide slice of orange down the inside of the glass is the only garnish it wants.

items.q: How much alcohol is in a can?
items.a: Between 4.5% and 5% ABV depending on the flavour, which is roughly one standard aperitivo serve. Every can prints its exact strength on the base.

items.q: Is it really ready to drink?
items.a: Completely. Nothing to mix, top up, or stir. Chill it, crack it, pour it over ice, and that is the entire method.
Yes. The can and the ring are aluminium and endlessly recyclable, and the outer packs are uncoated board with no plastic wrap.

find.heading: FIND AURELLO *NEAR YOU.*
find.body: Stocked in independent bottle shops, delis and wine bars, with more arriving every month. Tell us your postcode and we will point you at the closest cold one.

footer.statement: A bittersweet aperitivo spritz, built for the hour when the light goes orange and nobody wants to leave.
footer.responsible: Please enjoy Aurello responsibly. Not for sale to anyone under the legal drinking age.
